messages.subject: Website is disconnected
parts:
Want to dos oemthing similar to this - http://glimmer.rstudio.com/szakacs/test3/

This is what we have done -

a. Wrote an App for Shiny server that is being run on port 8100
b. We are hosting our own web service using Apache
c. We have forwarded the output of Shiny by making the following changes to /etc/apache2/sites-available/default -

           ProxyPass / http://localhost:8100/
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:8100/

d. Link to the website is - http://sp2013-paolopi-ub.cloudapp.net/ but is coming out to be broken.

Questions -

* Not married to apache and open to other ideas any suggestions and What is normally used to host application developed in Shiny and R?
* What might be going wrong for us here? very confused as Apache server is working fine otherwise.
* BTW, has anyone having issues with Internet Explorer. The above app works on the local network when rendered in Chrome but does not work in IE. IE and Webhosting Both of them might be related issues.

Looking forward to your help here as we are working on a tight deadline.

Regards

Mehar

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Website is disconnected
parts:
We do not recommend using Apache directly with R. See the page on deployment:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#deployment-web

Using Shiny Server will fix IE as well. Normally Shiny doesn't work with IE because it is based on the websocket protocol, which is not implemented in IE9 and earlier. However, Shiny Server includes a compatibility bridge for IE8/9.
